Title: Himalayan Organic Nettle Tea (Almora Region)
• 100% PURE HIMALAYAN SOURCE: Handpicked in Almora, Uttarakhand high-altitudes.
• CAFFEINE-FREE ENERGY: Rich in minerals and iron to revitalise naturally.
• HERBAL TRADITION: Used in Uttarakhand communities as a cleansing infusion.
Deep in the high-altitude forests of the Almora region, stinging nettle is more than just
a wild herb—it is a traditional wellness companion. Our Pure Himalayan Nettle Tea is
mindfully harvested by women's self-help groups. We dry the leaves slowly to capture the
true earthiness and natural calcium. Every sip tells the story of Uttarakhand's pristine hills.
Excellent as a hot brew or iced infusion. Supports sustainable local farming.
Characters: 840 | Words: 135 | SEO Keyword Match: High
